","source":"export function slugify(value: string): string {
  const lower = value.toLowerCase();
  // Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with spaces
  const noPunct = lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ' ');
  // Collapse multiple spaces into single hyphen
  const collapsed = noPunct.replace(/\s+/g, '-');
  // Remove leading/trailing hyphens
  return collapsed.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}"}

- Converts "Hello, world!" to "hello-world"
- Collapses tabs and repeated punctuation to a single hyphen (snake_case → snake-case)
- Removes leading/trailing hyphens
- Returns empty string for punctuation-only input
